newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-6-mo T-bills yields hold steady.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-6-mo T-bills yields hold steady.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 57.25 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 3, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Thursday.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 6.399 million UAH 25.52 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.999 million UAH 22.33 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 63,990 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for September 10.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills stood at 64.38 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 3, a central bank statement said.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 26.420 million UAH 9.128 million UAH
Actual amount raised 22.385 million UAH 6.910 million UAH
The central bank sold 264,201 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for September 5.
